## Definition of Done

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion on the linked issue passes
- [ ] The code runs from a clean clone (`git clone` then the setup commands in README)
- [ ] At least one automated test covers the new behaviour
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, `.env` files, or database dumps in the diff
- [ ] No commented-out dead code left behind
- [ ] README or `docs/` updated if the setup steps changed
